note: Harvard Dataverse copies (owner, 14 Nov 2026). scripts/dataverse.mjs creates the collection and one dataset per country on its first run, then publishes a new version when a file on the website changed. Datasets are found by title in the collection, so a title here never changes once published.

collection.name: Southeast Asia Transport Data
collection.description: Open data behind six independent travel guides to Laos, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, the Philippines and Indonesia: border crossings and checkpoints, bus, train and ferry routes, transit places and transport maps in eight languages. Each dataset is copied from its website, where the newest files always live.

laos.title: Laos Border Checkpoints, Routes and Transport Map (LaosBusTickets)

thailand.title: Thailand Transport Map: Places, Corridors and Border Crossings (Thailand Transport Hub)

vietnam.title: Vietnam Border Crossings and Transport Map (VietnamTransportGuide)

cambodia.title: Cambodia Border Crossings and Transport Map (CambodiaTransportGuide)

philippines.title: Philippines Ferry Routes, Ports and Transport Map (PhilippinesTransport)

indonesia.title: Indonesia Transport Routes, Ports and Transport Map (IndonesiaTransport)
